questions.question: If $A\in\mathcal L(V,W)$ and $B\in\mathcal L(U,V)$, what is the product $AB$?
options: The scalar product of two vectors.
The map from $W$ to $U$ defined by $B(Au)$.
questions.explanation: The product $AB$ denotes composition in right-to-left order: first apply $B:U\to V$, then apply $A:V\to W$. Thus $(AB)(u)=A(Bu)$ and $AB:U\to W$.
